declarations.type:
∀ (state : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.ServerState)
  (expectedRevision : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.Revision)
  (nextGeneration : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.Generation)
  (nextDigest : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.Digest),
  expectedRevision ≠ state.revision →
    ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.publishCAS state expectedRevision nextGeneration nextDigest = none
declarations.name: ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.stale_revision_publish_is_rejected

declarations.type:
∀ (state : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.ServerState)
  (nextGeneration : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.Generation)
  (nextDigest : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.Digest),
  ¬state.activeGeneration < nextGeneration →
    ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.publishCAS state state.revision nextGeneration nextDigest = none

declarations.type:
∀ (state next : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.ServerState)
  (expectedRevision : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.Revision)
  (nextGeneration : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.Generation)
  (nextDigest : ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.Digest),
  ASPProof.ServerResidentSearchGeneration.publishCAS state expectedRevision nextGeneration nextDigest = some next →
    state.activeGeneration < next.activeGeneration
